profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary: I'm currently a student at Middlebury College pursuing a double major in Computer Science and Mathematics. This summer (2017) will be my third internship at Apple. My first summer, I worked on app development, and last summer and this summer, I've been working on machine learning projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer on the iMessage team at Apple. I specialize in our transport and persistence layers, but work all throughout our stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: I'm currently working on a full stack project involving JavaScript in the front end and machine learning in python in the back end.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: My second summer at Apple, I worked on a handful of diverse projects. The first project was writing an internal tool in Swift. After that, I transitioned to working on a machine learning project with another intern and a few full-time members on the team. Finally, I contributed to some Swift Playgrounds code.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description: During my first internship with Apple, I worked closely with a graphic design intern and an instructional design intern to create a macOS application. We built the app from the ground up, and (with lots of help from full-time employees) I wrote all the Swift code that brought it to life.
